summary: Identity merge power and transformation. This concentrated pattern asks you to use confidence and depth with awareness.
body: Identity merge power and transformation. This concentrated pattern asks you to use confidence and depth with awareness. Identity meets power and intensity. A magnetic, high-voltage presence that others react to immediately. These drives sit close together, so the pattern may feel natural, immediate, and hard to separate. In practice, this can show up through identity, power and transformation, and the choices you make when ego defense or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is confidence, depth, and a more conscious way to work with identity and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is ego defense, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Name how identity and power and transformation are both involved
Turn confidence and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Let ego defense make the decision
Assume what feels natural is automatically balanced
Ignore the needs of identity or power and transformation
